title: Getting started with ZICDT
text: zicdt_fit() learns globally optimal structure given penalty alpha. Note parameterization: alpha multiplies KL fit, larger alpha yields denser structure.
code: fit <- zicdt_fit(sim$data, alpha = 2) fit #> ZICDT directed tree #>   nodes: 5  |  edges: 4  |  roots: 1 #>   penalty (alpha): 2 #>   score: 175.6170 #>   edges: #>     1 -> 2 #>     2 -> 3 #>     1 -> 4 #>     4 -> 5 zicdt_edges(fit) #>   parent child #> 1      1     2 #> 2      2     3 #> 3      1     4 #> 4      4     5

what: Choose the penalty by cross-validation (main workflow)
title: Getting started with ZICDT
text: zicdt_cv() runs K-fold cross-validation grid penalties, selects one minimizing --sample KL loss, refits final tree. usual entry point. learned directed tree available adjacency matrix (cvfit$adjacency, adjacency[k, j] == 1 meaning edge k -> j), tidy edge list via zicdt_edges(cvfit), igraph object (cvfit$graph). fitted edge transition matrices cvfit$params.
code: cvfit <- zicdt_cv(sim$data, alpha_grid = c(seq(0.1, 1, 0.1), 2, 5), K = 3) cvfit #> ZICDT directed tree #>   nodes: 5  |  edges: 4  |  roots: 1 #>   penalty (alpha): 0.3 #>   score: 29.7425 #>   edges: #>     1 -> 2 #>     2 -> 3 #>     1 -> 4 #>     4 -> 5 cvfit$alpha        # selected penalty #> [1] 0.3 head(cvfit$cv)     # per-penalty CV table #>   alpha fold test_kl_loss num_edges #> 1   0.1    1     40.41311         0 #> 2   0.2    1     34.14181         2 #> 3   0.3    1     31.58412         4 #> 4   0.4    1     31.58412         4 #> 5   0.5    1     31.58412         4 #> 6   0.6    1     31.58412         4

title: Structure Learning for Directed Trees with Zero-Inflated Compositional Nodes
text: Structure Learning Directed Trees Zero-Inflated Compositional Nodes ZICDT learns directed tree (forest) node entire zero-inflated composition probability simplex. scores candidate edges Kullback–Leibler divergence (finite exact zeros), models child’s conditional mean mixture baseline parent-driven, column-stochastic transition map, fits edge parameters EM algorithm (C++ via Rcpp), finds globally optimal spanning arborescence Chu–Liu/Edmonds algorithm (virtual root accommodates forests), selects edge penalty cross-validation.

title: Structure Learning for Directed Trees with Zero-Inflated Compositional Nodes
text: Requires C++ compiler Rcpp RcppArmadillo.
code: # from the package directory devtools::install("ZICDT")     # or: R CMD INSTALL ZICDT

title: Structure Learning for Directed Trees with Zero-Inflated Compositional Nodes
code: library(ZICDT)  ## simulate a 5-node tree:  1->2->3 and 1->4->5 G <- matrix(0, 5, 5); G[1,2] <- 1; G[2,3] <- 1; G[1,4] <- 1; G[4,5] <- 1 sim <- zicdt_simulate(G, d = c(8,10,12,9,11), n = 100, seed = 7)  ## fit at a fixed penalty fit <- zicdt_fit(sim$data, alpha = 2) print(fit) zicdt_edges(fit)  ## select the penalty by cross-validation cvfit <- zicdt_cv(sim$data, alpha_grid = c(seq(0.1, 1, 0.1), 2, 5), K = 5) print(cvfit) cvfit$alpha    # selected penalty cvfit$cv       # per-penalty CV table

title: Structure Learning for Directed Trees with Zero-Inflated Compositional Nodes

title: Select the penalty by cross-validation and fit the final structure — zicdt_cv
text: data named list n x d_j compositional matrices (see zicdt_fit). alpha_grid Numeric vector candidate penalties. NULL, default grid c(seq(0.01,0.09,0.01), seq(0.1,1,0.1)) used. K Number cross-validation folds (default 5). em_max_iter, em_eps EM iteration cap convergence tolerance. use_parallel Parallelize folds (default FALSE; sequential portable, package-safe path). seed Optional integer. supplied, cross-validation fold split (stochastic step; edge EM fitting deterministic) seeded result exactly reproducible. Pass per-replicate seed make whole simulation study reproducible, including parallel execution. verbose FALSE (default), suppress engine's console output.

text: data named list n x d_j matrices, one per node; row composition (nonnegative, sums 1). matrices must share number rows n. alpha Edge penalty (larger alpha -> sparser structure). penalty_rate Per-edge complexity penalty (default 1). em_max_iter, em_eps EM iteration cap convergence tolerance. verbose FALSE (default), suppress engine's console output.

what: Simulate zero-inflated compositional data on a directed tree — zicdt_simulate
title: Simulate zero-inflated compositional data on a directed tree — zicdt_simulate
text: Generates data paper's model: edge \(k \j\) child conditional mean \(\omega_0 \eta_j + \omega_1 M_{jk} x^{(k)}\) column-stochastic transition matrix \(M_{jk}\); observations drawn \(x^{(j)} \sim \mathrm{Dir}(\kappa \cdot \widehat{x}^{(j)})\).

title: Simulate zero-inflated compositional data on a directed tree — zicdt_simulate
code: zicdt_simulate(   true_G,   d = 50,   n = 100,   omega1 = 0.95,   precision = 20,   zero_inflate = 0,   no_dead_cols = FALSE,   seed = NULL )

title: Simulate zero-inflated compositional data on a directed tree — zicdt_simulate
text: true_G p x p 0/1 adjacency matrix true directed tree, true_G[k, j] == 1 means \(k \j\) (k parent j). column must one non-zero entry (one parent). d Integer vector length p giving node's compositional dimension, single integer used nodes. n Number samples (subjects). omega1 Parental-influence weight (\(\omega_1\)); \(\omega_0 = 1 - \omega_1\). precision Dirichlet precision \(\kappa\) controlling dispersion. zero_inflate Optional target zero fraction [0, 1). > 0, observation forced exactly floor(zero_inflate * d_j) zero components: smallest-abundance entries (including already zero Dirichlet underflow) become structural zeros row renormalized. yields zero-inflated Dirichlet whose realized zero rate equals zero_inflate (provided exceeds small natural rate), zeros occurring low abundance real compositional data. no_dead_cols Logical; TRUE, zero-injection column (component) became zero every observation rescued restoring largest original value one subject, guaranteeing every component present least one observation (real data). Default FALSE. seed Optional integer seed.

title: Simulate zero-inflated compositional data on a directed tree — zicdt_simulate
text: list data (length-p list n x d_j   matrices) true_G (adjacency matrix used).

title: ZICDT 0.1.0
text: Initial release. zicdt_cv() learns directed tree/forest edge penalty chosen K-fold cross-validation; zicdt_fit() fits fixed penalty. zicdt_simulate() generates zero-inflated compositional data known tree. C++ EM engine via Rcpp/RcppArmadillo; Chu-Liu/Edmonds tree search.
